Light travels at about 300,000 kilometre.why: The round figure is stated in Wikipedia's Speed of light article and thousands of times in Dolma; the exact value is 299,792,458 m/s.

sources.quote: Because light travels about 300000 kilometres (186000 miles) in one second, these measurements of small fractions of a second must be very precise.
The constant c is defined in the International System of Units (SI) as exactly 299792458 m/s.
